CHAPTER.CAPTION: Psalm of David
CHAPTER.VERS: Jehovah is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? Jehovah is the stronghold of my life. Who is there to be afraid of?
Evildoers accosted me to tear me to pieces. My opponents and enemies stumbled and fell.
Even though an army sets up camp against me, my heart will not be afraid. Even though a war breaks out against me, I will trust in Jehovah.
I have asked one thing from Jehovah. This I will seek: to live in the house of Jehovah all the days of my life, to look at Jehovahs beauty and search for an answer in his temple.
He hides me in his shelter when there is trouble. He keeps me hidden in his tent. He puts me high on a rock.
Now my head will be lifted up above my enemies who surround me. I will offer sacrifices with shouts of joy in his tent. I will sing, yes I will sing praises to Jehovah.
Hear O Jehovah when I cry with my voice. Be gracious to me and answer me.
You said: »Seek my face .« My heart said to you, »O Jehovah, I will look for you.«
Do not hide your face from me. Do not angrily turn me away. You have been my help. Do not leave me! Do not abandon me, O God of my salvation!
Even if my father and mother abandon me, Jehovah will take care of me.
Teach me your way, O Jehovah. Lead me on a level path because of my enemies.
Do not surrender me to the will of my opponents. False witnesses have risen against me. They breathe out violence.
I believe that I will see the goodness of Jehovah in this world of the living.

Hope
in Jehovah and be strong. Let your heart be courageous. Yes, hope in Jehovah.
